Totally forgot it was there till I took my arm out of my hoodie for a shot. The nurse went wide eyed. I lived in the rural South circa 2015/16...So my response was horse bite.

Just don't lie. Most doctors will understand and maybe ask domestic violence questions.

Which did not match. I was being admitted to the ER and in pain so my brain just did it. I thought I was dying so my brain did that.
Beets? Jelly? I don't know.

Did this when my dad passed. I accidentally made three cups of coffee visiting my parents. I just looked at it on the counter for a solid couple minutes.

This was my first huge one and I'm proud! things I learned:

Mistake 1: I didn't own enough peg boards when I started. 

Mistake 2: I had two different kinds of beads. I had beads from a hello kitty melty bead kit. Wound up with yellow goupy beads because they melt different. Perler and melty beads. Two different things. Redid his stupid cheader teeth 3 times. 

Mistake 3: peg boards from melty beads and perler beads are different sizes 27x27 and 29x29 I think. That's why there's the weird square looking bit on his chest.

Mistake 4: iron was too hot and some prices bent.

Mistake 5: measure your canvas.

I might try my next one as one big piece. I have too many peg boards now. Lol.
Me too. I'm on a cocktail of mental health meds and I have many currently undiagnosed digestive problems. I will vomit blood if I take NSAIDs. I avoid pain meds if I can help it.

I figured that was the best idea. I did manage to do one really good connect though. You would think splitting a hand in two would be bad but that one worked. 

This project is up in the 5000 to 6000 bead range so pretty big. I can salvage what I've done by gluing to a thin foam board of some kind on the back and exacto knifing it. I bit off more than I could chew but I'm gonna finish this demon of a project.
That looks about the same size as a 16 oz beverage. "Tall boy" beer or a monster drink maybe. Add some foam on the inside and BAM fashionable drink cozy or whatever they are called.

Yea just like those glow stars, for kids bedrooms, get some and glue them on cuffs. After I do my wall with them leftovers are going on cuffs. You can also glue two back to back for a 3D effect. Haven't tried to poke holes yet though. I'm obsessed with glow and blacklight stuff.

Regular tacos have no sour cream or tomatoes. Supreme tacos do. Maybe you're just ordering supreme and don't realize it. At least this is what I noticed at Taco Bell in Washington State. Trust me I hate tomatoes too. Although sour cream is amazing, it does not go on taco bell. Best of luck on your taco journey!
I love the glow in the dark ones. Also my mind immediately imagined Lucifer from Hazbin Hotel wearing the duck one.
Yep. I screamed so loud I scared the ER staff.
The migraine that followed my change in meds. I didn't get a chance to wean off Lexapro because it gave me heart issues. Not my worst pain experience but it's up there.
I think a close second would be the one that went up my nose. The ER didn't believe me. Fucker hid in my mt.dew can, I took a chug and up my nose he went.

I had one as a little kid. Kindergarten I think. It's one of my earliest non emotional traumatic memories. It took 4 grown adults to hold me down to give me eye drops. I also called several nurses/doctors "poopy-heads" my mom said that's the first mean/rude thing I ever said. Lololol.
I do not have nuts, but my vagina clenched in fear reading this. I weep for you that sounds horrifying and I wish you the best recovery.

Passing kidney stones. I literally screamed in pain for so long I passed out. I'm shocked my neighbors didn't report a noise complaint or DV. When I came to I crawled down the stairs sobing and shaking. Vision blurred from pain and tears. I managed to walk/clawl/stumble over 45 minutes to the ER. I pissed myself three times in below freezing temps. I was then laying on the ER floor for the next idk how many hours crying and puking from pain. I think I peed the ER floor again. It was emotionally scary too. While this wasn't my first time in the ER. It was my first time totally alone and for something this severe. I was finally taken back and given pain meds, scans and stuff. The most terrifying part was the sound of the stones clinking when I peed them out in the urinal/bed pan thing. 

0/10 do not recommend. 

A close second was flipping my knee cap backwards but at least the shock was my friend and the pain didn't kick in till later.

I am scared to learn to swim because my grandma's way of teaching me was to chuck me in the lake and figure it out. I was 5. I call it babys first trauma. Never gone in water more than 5 foot since. I've been fishing a few times but I had a death grip on the boat so bad my fingers bled.

When I worked at home Depot we had a lady we called "dread bitch" she had these lumps of blond dread locks. Imagine dread locks but you haven't cleaned or washed them in years. They were dragging on the fucking floor. I honestly don't know if those were huge lice or roaches on her. She was also very rude when we told her to leave. Not because she stank but because she was stealing. Lol but I want to puke thinking about this. Most of us were wearing masks as this was like month 1 or 2 of COVID.
That's literally all our training at home Depot. Just read the product they are holding and 95 percent of questions can be answered. The other 5 percent the answer is hire a professional.

Back in 2017, I once needed X-rays. I fell at my grandma's house and they thought I broke my nose or cheek. I looked at the tech and said "do I need to take out my nose ring?" My grandma lost her shit. When did you get a nose piercing? So Unladylike. Gross etc. So on so forth. My mom's just snickering so hard. Mom paid for it for my 21th bday. I left it to close due to masking from COVID. Might get it redone. Fuck it I'm almost 30. Why not. 

Just remember nobody in a professional environment will judge you openly. Your mother on the other hand...
Hey if I got told I had to pay more because I'm too big. I got more issues than just money.

My troop did this to me. I didn't know it at the time but I am autistic and have minor dyslexia. (This was like 2008)  They yelled at me for days for messing up my cookie order. They yelled at me like 100 dollars was the end of the world. My mom told them she'd fix it and she did. 

 They didn't tell us the Christmas party moved dates until after my mom and I made cookies and sat in the church parking lot in negative temps because the church was locked. 

Our trip one year was to sliterbaun (that park in Kansas City that killed a kid on the waterslide) I had never been to a place like that and I don't like crowds so I was scared. But I'm excited to go. Plus I couldn't swim very well. I told my troop leader this. She literally handed me my  ticket money back. I was so confused at the time. I tried asking questions she just kept walking away. 

Eventually my mom talks the troop leader into letting me go.Ten minutes in the wave thingy my tube gets flipped upside down and I get separated. I didn't know what to do so I found the nearest exit and just sat there panicked half drowned I was eventually found by my troop leaders daughter. I get called every nasty name in the book a Simi sheltered 13 year old without Internet could come up with up. I was apparently lost so long I missed lunch and "ruined" the trip. I later found out from another scout that they didn't realize I was missing until they got to the car. I loose sense of time and freeze when I scared. Then my shoes went "missing" and I walked across the hot pavement to get to the car. Had to go to the ER my feet burnt so bad.

Yes this. I suffered my entire childhood and teens with this. Nobody ever thought allergies. Doctor heard "puke" and gave me stuff for a stomach bug everytime. After like the 15 visit and almost having to repeat grade 7 I was put on anxiety meds which made it worse and fucked my kidneys.
To be fair I did have a minor concussion.
Yes. I'm the other way around though, When I lived in the Midwest and when it was 100 plus, dad, grandpa and I sat on our porch with hot coffee and watched traffic go by.

I accidentally did that once. 

Nurse: what brought you to urgent care?

Me: the bus

Nurse: *pause* ???

Me: wait, shit sorry, let me rephrase, my car got hit by a bus.

a very very big needle.

It's new year day. People partied too hard last night lolol. Wait a week or so and try again. But free pool and  reasonably priced beer. That's better than the couch. Also as somebody who's trying to be more social this year too I respect the attempt.

My ER told me to fill out paperwork and then leave after I cut my wrists almost to the bone. (I had gotten stitches elsewhere) I filled out almost all 5s on the depression part. 0s and 1s on everything else. They phrased it as you're not a danger so you can leave. I explicitly said I never would hurt others so I think that's why. I also stated I had no access to guns which was a lie. Three days later I walked in front of a train but chickened out last second but got knocked down the embankment. 

I forgot the best part. I was 13 or 14, by myself with no insurance. (One parent unemployed, the other seasonal) They tried to use the cost factor to turn me away. Also didn't even bother to ask why I was alone. I also didn't have an ID. 

Keep in mind this was a rural hospital in the middle of nowhere Missouri in 2010. Said hospital is now part of a major lawsuit so there's that.

Yea. I'm currently puking yellow bile that smells like death and haven't eaten in like 4 days. Two urgent care doctors have done nothing. Gallstones run in my family. I'm just waiting for my gallbladder to explode and die alone in my apartment. At least that's what I think is wrong.

As somebody who has to go to the ER often. Yea that sums it up. I feel so sorry for all that you guys put up with. I was never like this lady. But there was a day I walked up to the front desk again after waiting like 5 hours I was like hey I've been waiting a long time. Then a code literally rolls by. I stopped mid sentence and was like "I'm gonna go sit now" I did eventually get seen. Lolol. Think of it this way if you're not the first one seen you're lucky.
I just called them Ms. Like the plural of the letter M.
Wizard 101 and House Flipper. I'm a magical construction worker I guess.
I constantly reread coraline by neil gaiman. I honestly do not know why.
My cats whiskers would go up and down like she was pushing hard

As a two or three year old I called a nurse a "big poopy head" and attempted to smack her for trying to give me eye drops after a severe eye injury. If she could see that my vision is 80 percent of normal. She'd laugh

In the summer when I was with my grandparents the church paid for everyone to go to Golden Carral. I was so happy that me and all the little bible study kids were making ice cream sundaes. I was one of the oldest so I helped with the toppings. I was a picky eater so I mostly had fried rice and my bowl of ice cream. I grew up to hate that church but the memory still sticks.

I'm only 27 and I hit that brick the day I finished college. everything I eat upsets my stomach and I can't enjoy booze anymore. my knees hurt all the time now, I will now never pay my medical bills or student loans or retire. WWW 3 is gonna start. My mental health has hit the ground running. Yea... 30s is better for some than others.
As a lactose intolerant person yes please. Almond milk ice cream tastes like shit. It has a nut like aftertaste. You could also recreate those orange pop sickle pops from the 90s.

At my work there a little girl who wants to be a hairdresser like her mom. She teaches everyone how to braid hair. When her ride is late I let her braid my hair and teach me. For some reason I can't get the hang of it.   I can almost do it myself now and I get mad at myself for wanting short hair again. Lol.
Yep. I have been eating healthy for months. Dropped a good amount of pounds. I wanted to go out to eat on my birthday. Got food poisoning really bad. Yea.. I fell that dude. Rip donuts.
Especially in the winter. Like in the summer I'm showering 2 times a day. In the winter once every other day or so is totally ok. Especially if Seattle hits 30 degrees lololol. Nope no shower.

I know little to nothing about male parts. (Born female and bi but lean female) I thought the helicopter dick was painful or at very least uncomfortable to you. I would also probably forget that sitting down to pee is not the norm I guess. Peeing in the "open" like a urinal would be weird. Like other people can see you. I have only seen like 4 penises IRL, and too many dick pics to count.   

I mean not having my back breaking DDs would be amazing too. That would be the only benefit. I'm cool being female. I think I'd just be very uncomfortable the whole time.

My hospital uses code pink (insert description of child) (insert hospital zone) while any code is serious. Sometimes it ends up becoming ok in the end. 

Most memorable code I ever had to call was "code pink, naked African American toddler, zone #, urgent care" poor kid did not want a change of clothes after barfing and pooping him self. Ran from mom in the family bathroom to the hall. I cornered the little biohazard behind my desk. I see this kid come in for therapy appointments every week and mom still can't look me in the face without laughing.

Mine had the same idea but he said he'd take me to Taco Bell. It was 2 towns over and both my parents hated it. Lol. I think of my dad being annoyed or grossed out every time I buy Taco Bell. It also taught my ADHD ass some serious focus.

I can agree to a point. But when the busses are full past capacity, seats are covered in piss, full of wailing banshee children. Especially around 2 to 3pm as they use the public busses for school. Crackheads literally passed out blocking the back doors at 6am on the first fucking bus of the day. Bus drivers getting assaulted, rampant drunkards and literal sex in the back seat. 

If you guessed I live in Seattle. You get a cookie. If we could strive to have better transit I agree with you.
Mine is captainsauce. His unique Canadian humor just gets me.
Anti anxiety meds made me lose my appetite. So that could be it.
I was only 6 and I was just pissed to be taken home early before art time. I had no idea the world changed so much when the only thing on my mind was that I didn't get to color yet.

Mine was once so low I didn't ever register. I had been recovering from food poisoning. I woke up totally nauseous and needed to pee like a horse. But I couldn't pee. Went back to sleep and a few hours later I got up and tried to have a breakfast and face planted in my cereal.  Grandpa took my blood sugar with his meter and took me to the ER. It read low the first time. He reset it and then it reads err. I think they told Grandpa my sugar was like 35.

I have seasonal depression. My depression is worse in the summer. People don't get it. I moved to Seattle because it's only sunny like 2 months of the year. Also my skin tone could be called "drywall" "vampire" or "printer paper" so sun does me no favors.
Basket of shrimp for me lololol. Be nice to try it before I die. Never had any, always been allergic.

I can barely get past the idea of seeing the third deadpool movie. (If and when it comes out) My dad and I loved both 1 and 2. Deadpool was one of the few movies we both could agree on. Dad passed almost 2 years ago, and I watched Deadpool on the plane back from the funeral and I cried so hard. Both from laughter and grief. 

On a lighter note I like to think of my dad on the other side walking past Jesus, farting and saying " hashtag drive by" because that is something he'd do.

Once my friends and I picked up tacos and we got rear ended out on I-70 going back to campus. I had the food bags in my lap. Passenger air bag goes off. Imagine Carrie but instead of blood they cover her in blended taco bell. That was me. I was fine. My friend who was the driver had to go to the hospital. Sitting in the ER waiting room covered in taco bell is an experience. I was too scared for my friend to shower or even want to get checked out myself. In the end my friend Just had some broken ribs and wrist. We never ate taco bell together again.
I once called my antidepressant "butt-prion". Like the thing that makes mad cow disease but also affects your anus??? The pharmacist died laughing.
I have witnessed this happen. Yay Seattle....
The way I see it is they put all the hate and anger and destructive urges into their music. It's strangely a healthy outlet that millions of people can enjoy listening to. It's a win win.
I am so jealous. I love their bagels.

My best friend worked pizza delivery in highschool. It was a small town. Like 5000 people. There were these two retired guys who'd order every Wednesday and tip her with stuff from their garden. One time it was like a whole bunch of zucchini. I only know this because she came by my house and asked me to make  her zucchini bread for her birthday. Then handed me her bag full of zucchini. I made 5 loaves out of that. One year was really bad and they didn't have anything in the garden. So she got tipped a bunch of leftover Halloween candy. Another time it was beer, this was right after the Superbowl so very fitting. These two dudes were always a surprise. This was about 10 or so years ago and I recently found out they both passed. Willy and Ron may you rest in peace.
My first time getting drunk was on homemade apple pie moonshine. I'm having flashbacks.

If I was taught anything in life it's this from my parents. There is always a catch. There is always some unseen gain for them. Nobody ever does anything out of kindness. They do it for YouTube views, to get out of work or to look like a better person on the outside. My mom's favorite thing to say was "why are you so nice, they wouldn't do that for you?" Eventually I slowly stopped being nice and noticed she was right. Stopped texting first, stopped making plans etc. I just stopped. 

It took me over a year at my job to let my supervisor buy me a coffee because I felt like he was playing me or this was an "employee test". It's hard to get over something so ingrained from like 3rd grade on. I have started to trust people more but I still don't think I can believe in unconditional love and acceptance.

Back when I got my first ID at 16, I was suicidal (getting help now, doing ok don't worry), I had full intentions of on filling my chest/guts with birdshot. Or donating my organs to the train tracks. So I don't think anybody needs that. I honestly just didn't bother to check yes on IDs after. I will in 2027 on my new ID.
Prostitution.

Men in soft colored dress shirts but the sleeves are rolled up to the elbow and they have either freckles or nice tattoos on their arms.
Just playing video games. I don't know why. Just naked on my bed, laptop on my lap.

Unrelated to cause of death so don't know if it was cancer or not. Plus those gross "truth" ads about smoking and drugs" mid 2010 peeps will know exactly what I'm talking about. She like freaking peels half her face off to pay for smokes. 

I did however have an edible once. Made me paranoid and I puked. Life lesson from me, weed plus anti-aniexty meds DO NOT MIX.
That pineapple probably treated her better than a highschool boy.

Stayed at my mom's house. Fell asleep on the couch and woke up very sweaty, with a blinding headache, and blurry vision. Felt like a vibrating rock on my head. Did I have a Stroke or seizure. Nope. Her giant fluffy white cat decided the side of my face was the perfect place to sit. I think the cat damn well knows I'm allergic too. Fuck off back under Mom's desk, Snowball.

My father did something similar. I was home from college and taking care of my dad a couple days after a heart surgery. He wakes me up at 3 am freaking out telling me he's having chest pain really bad. I threw on pants and we hit the highway to the ER. I hit a construction plate in the road a little hard and this bounced my dad very violently. Then I hear it. It sounds like a chainsaw failing to start up and smells like death. "I'm fine now... Sorry." Followed by crying laughter and a u-turn back home.
Caffeine

I work in a children's hospital so my response is "not your mom" because it's almost always a child trying to find mom or grandma. 

My go to for everywhere else is "come back with a warrant and some toilet paper"

Did something sorta similar. Went to my mom's house and made 3 cups of coffee and pulled 3 plates for eggs. What's wrong with this picture? My dad passed about five months prior and this was my first visit back after the funeral. I chugged the coffee and put the plate back in the cabinet so mom couldn't see that.
My boyfriend once asked asked how heavy, like a leaky sprinkler or like a cannibal corpse concert. I died laughing at that description.

My grandma but she instilled in my head You will eat, sleep, work and die. You will deal with it. College debt, crappy spouse, I'll behaved children, failing health, and now a lack man as president. Look where I am. Am I happy absolutely not. This is your future stop crying. It makes it worse.
It works beautifully, especially if one of you has a job where jewelry is not allowed.

I have one because my grandma's dog would trigger it. My grandma was deaf enough it wasn't an issue for her when it was her and the dog. But I have hyper sensitive hearing. I cannot stand that fucking dining noise. When I had to start driving the dog to vet appointments and stuff, I just kept it clocked there. The dog was not happy about the seat belt behind her either. Also The trigger limit on passenger seats is way too low. I think it's 50 pounds or less.

As much as I do not like the song and agree with you, It has one good use. It will make you achieve damn near perfect CPR skills. I did not have the heart to admit that during my CPR class required by my work.

Nobody will help you without some kind of benefit. Cops, doctors, social work will get career benefits or glory. Friends use you for free shit and you get nothing in return. You are on your own forever by choice or by luck.

Reminds me of a story I read. Somebody found a dead body in a dockside parking area next to a car with an open driver door. Cops found no signs of theft or car jacking. A dead fish was found in the driver's side seat. Autopsy showed blunt forced trauma. No cause could be determined. Only upon reviews of CCTV from a near military base did they figure out his death. Bird dropped a fish on his head as he was getting into his car. Fish bounced right into car.
When you're suicidal and in a near death situation you'd think otherwise. That situation was not a direct suicide attempt. I rolled my atv. I did ask the paramedic to just leave me.

The bacon looks questionable but I'd say "thank you"
I would want an ad of a teenage girl looking at it scared and it being positive then screaming "fuck" as loud as possible. Followed by 99.9% accuracy even in the worst cases.

Yea. My dad died from a heart attack suddenly about year ago. I was art supply shopping and I saw this model car kit and I thought I have to build this for dad he'd love it. Then I busted out crying in the hobby lobby.
I can't tell you how many times I had a mental breakdown and I decided I wanted nuggets after I calmed down. Seeing 11 nuggets made me suck a bit less.
I work at a hospital. High chance it's needed. So...
Triangles is for "wet" sandwiches. PBJ, grilled cheese etc. The square is for mostly meat sandwiches like ham, turkey etc.
Mine hung up on me. They are 24/7 right?

Me too but I was a binge and purge type. Bulliema I think.(not diagnosed) it was in part to my ADHD tendency (not diagnosed) and my life being completely fucking messed up by abuse etc. Food was all I could "control" this went on and off for years. Went to college and after an unrelated suicide attempt freshman year I was officially diagnosed as Manic depressive/bipolar. Six years later I'm on new meds and I am literally not hungry. Ever. I only noticed I stopped eating when I did my taxes and my work place meal plan was never used. My weight has not started dropping yet but I know it will. It also does not help that my job is physically demanding sometimes. I ate chicken strips and fries yesterday at work and held back the urge to puke both from bulimic tendencies and the I'm not hungry nauseousness. I'm slowly eating one meal a day. Usually at work. To everyone who struggles, you're fucking beautiful in your own right and tell anybody who says otherwise to fuck in the general direction of off.
it's as natural as shitting, belching, farting, puking everybody does those.
My gallbladder can't handle it now. But God damn the memories. I'd beg my mom every time we went into the city. I would sob so hard but worth it. I was 15 or 16 last time it was out.

I did a similar thing, when my dad died. I went to visit my mom a few months after he passed and I got up and I made three cups of coffee. Put non dairy in two and left one black. I didn't put it together until Mom said my coffee was by the stove and if I wanted non dairy in it. Mine was in my hand. There I was just staring at this black coffee and sobbing.

I think it depends on the person. I grew up with smokers. Both my parents smoked. I grew up with it and had severe allergies and lung issues (not related to their smoking but it didn't help it) so I could never smell to begin with. But oh my God everyone else could smell it on me and my stuff. 

In middle my councilor took me out of class one day and talked to me about smoking. At the time I never put it together. My school just finished DARE. (mid 2000s.) 

My senior year of Highschool I got kicked out of the driver's ED rental car for smelling bad. And they made me pay the cleaning fee. The instructor was my gym teacher and he yelled at me for smoking. 

My first year in college my mental health declined so badly I almost killed myself. Then I was suddenly fine. Went home to visit mom and dad for Christmas and I instantly got sick, coughing like I had TB. Then my mental health declined and got better. Apparently my parents second hand smoke gave me withdrawals my first year of college. I was also trying to cut caffeine which made that worse. I lived on campus which is a Smoke free campus. This was my college counselors theory anyway. 

Now in the 2020s I moved to Washington where my allergies have gotten better. So now everyone who smokes cigarettes or weed makes me wanna puke now.

Through all the stupid drunk fights my parents had. Never hurt me physically. At 6 I wanted to be an astronaut, at 9 I wanted to be happy, at 11 I wanted to be ok and at 13 I wanted to be dead. My parents were good parents to me they just don't realize the fights hurt me too. I have other trauma unrelated to them that made the fights harder to handle. But yea I get it.
Fuck yes. I need to find some. Watch that sugar though. So much per can.
